title: Kandy Day Tour
seoTitle: Kandy Day Tour | Temple, Gardens, Tea & Pinnawala | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private Kandy day tour: Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala, Peradeniya Botanical Garden, tea factory, Pinnawala elephants, spice garden, and batik workshop.
shortDescription: Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala, Peradeniya Gardens, tea factory, Pinnawala elephants, spice garden, and batik workshop.
overview:
A private full-day journey into Sri Lanka’s hill capital, built around culture, gardens, tea country, and elephants. Choose the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic or Nelligala Temple, then visit the National Botanical Garden at Peradeniya, a tea plantation and factory, Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage or an elephant park activity, a Ceylon Ayurveda herbal and spice garden, and a batik and saree factory.
Your chauffeur guide keeps the day flexible so you can linger where the atmosphere feels right. Entrance fees and lunch are not included.

highlights.title: Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala Temple
highlights.description: Visit Kandy’s Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic — one of Sri Lanka’s most important Buddhist sites — or choose Nelligala Temple for a quieter hilltop shrine and wide valley views. Tell us your preference when you book.

highlights.title: Peradeniya Botanical Garden
highlights.description: Stroll the National Botanical Garden at Peradeniya: royal palms, orchid houses, giant fig trees, and riverside lawns. Garden admission is paid on site and is not included.

highlights.title: Tea Plantation & Factory
highlights.description: Walk through a highland tea estate and visit a working factory to see how Ceylon tea is plucked, processed, and tasted.

highlights.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
highlights.description: Visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage to see rescued elephants at feeding or river time, or choose a nearby elephant park for a guided activity. Park tickets and optional activities are extra.

highlights.title: Ceylon Ayurveda Herbal & Spice Garden
highlights.description: Tour a Ceylon Ayurveda herbal and spice garden: cinnamon, pepper, cocoa, and traditional plant remedies, with a short tasting or demonstration.

highlights.title: Ceylon Batik & Saree Factory
highlights.description: See artisans at a Ceylon batik and saree workshop — wax-resist dyeing, handloom, and finished textiles. Shopping is optional.

highlights.title: Private hotel pickup and drop-off
highlights.description: Your chauffeur guide collects you from your hotel — typically Colombo, the west coast, or an agreed point — and returns you in the evening. Tell us your hotel when you book so we confirm pickup.

itinerary.title: Kandy culture, gardens, tea & elephants
itinerary.description: Morning hotel pickup, then a private circuit covering Pinnawala or an elephant park, a spice garden, tea plantation and factory, Peradeniya Botanical Garden, Temple of the Tooth or Nelligala Temple, and a batik and saree workshop. Evening return to your hotel.
